summary: Dyadic International filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 3,625,000 common shares at $0.795 per share, raising gross proceeds of $2.88 million, with Aegis Capital as placement agent. Concurrently, the company issued warrants to purchase an equal number of shares at $0.84 per share for $0.005 per warrant in a private placement. The offering is not a special situation but a routine capital raise. The closing is expected on August 14, 2026, subject to customary conditions. No strategic event or special-situation catalyst is present; the filing is an ordinary shelf takedown under Form S-3, subject to public float limitations.
